The *Nāmarūpaekattanānattapañha* ("The Question on the Identity or Difference of Name and Form Reborn") is a text located in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 3.2.6) [SuttaCentral]. The text deals with the identity or distinction of name-and-form (*nāmarūpa*) across rebirth. Modern translations cataloged by SuttaCentral include four translations across three languages, featuring an English translation by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].
